name: Saturate

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You draw moisture from the atmosphere to saturate the ground with water. If the terrain in the area is a hard surface such as stone, metal, or wood, it becomes difficult terrain. If it's a soft surface such as sand or dirt, the area becomes a quicksand hazard, except its size increases to fill the area.
